title: VAT - Senior Manager
description:
VAT - Senior Manager
Join a new and entrepreneurial VAT practice where you will have a genuine opportunity to help build something from the ground up.
As a VAT Senior Manager, you will support in the growth of our VAT practice, combining deep technical VAT expertise with client ownership, project leadership and assisting with business development. You will help shape our client offering, propositions and ways of working as the practice develops.
The work is varied and no two days are quite the same. You could be leading advice on a complex cross-border supply chain matter, overseeing a client’s VAT compliance challenge, developing a new opportunity or helping shape the future direction of the practice.
This is an opportunity to have a real voice in a growing practice. You will have significant autonomy to take ownership, develop areas of expertise and influence how we deliver VAT services, while working closely with experienced senior members of the team.
Roles & Responsibilities

Support and oversee the delivery of complex UK and international VAT advisory and compliance engagements, providing technically robust, practical and commercially focused advice.
Support and oversee a varied portfolio of VAT work, determining the appropriate approach, managing delivery and identifying wider risks, opportunities and solutions for clients.
Support the development of CFGI’s VAT technology capability, including ERP systems, tax engines, digital reporting, automation, AI and agentic workflows, and help shape how technology is embedded into the client offering.
Proactively contribute on business development activity, identifying new opportunities, developing client propositions and contributing to the growth of the VAT practice.

title: ITAM Solution Architect
description:
ServiceNow is moving from a workflow platform with AI features to an AI platform where agents do the work. That shift only works if the assets, licenses, and costs feeding it are accurate and under control - which is the problem this role owns.
The ITAM Solution Architect leads the technical design and delivery of ServiceNow IT Asset Management solutions for enterprise customers, translating business and financial governance requirements into scalable platform architecture. This role combines deep product expertise with the ability to advise customers on ITAM best practices, license optimization, and asset lifecycle strategy - serving as a trusted technical advisor throughout the engagement lifecycle.

• Lead solution architecture and design for ServiceNow ITAM implementations, including Hardware Asset Management (HAM), Software Asset Management (SAM), Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), and Cloud Cost Management (CCM)

• Define data models, integration patterns, and CMDB alignment strategies to support accurate asset lifecycle tracking

• Guide customers through discovery-to-normalization data flows and reconciliation processes

Advise and lead

• Give customers evidence-based assessments of ITAM maturity, license compliance risk, and cost optimization strategies - grounded in real current-state analysis, not generic best-practice assertions

• Partner with delivery teams to ensure architectural decisions are technically sound, scalable, and aligned to customer governance requirements

• Identify and proactively surface project risks, scope gaps, and technical debt to engagement leadership and customer stakeholders

• Mentor Technical Consultants and Business Process Consultants on ITAM design patterns

Why Join Us

• Influence multi-million-dollar transformation programs at the earliest stage.

• Work directly with enterprise customers on high-impact ServiceNow and AI-driven initiatives.

• Be part of a team that values both outcomes and excellence in delivery.

• Competitive compensation, performance bonuses, and clear career growth opportunities.

To be successful in this role you have:
Required

• Practical experience applying AI tools like Otto and AI Control Tower to asset management workflows, with the judgement to know where they add value and where they don't.

• Experience in IT asset management, software asset management, or related enterprise IT operations roles

• Demonstrated experience architecting ITAM solutions in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments

• Experience with ServiceNow Discovery and CMDB integration as it relates to asset data accuracy

• Executive presence and the ability to engage with stakeholders at all levels.

• A balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills, with a background in data governance, data catalogs, ontologies, business intelligence, engineering, or other technical fields.

• A collaborative, one-team mindset, skilled at working across sales, solution consulting, and delivery organizations.

Preferred

• Familiarity with ITAM industry frameworks (e.g., ISO/IEC 19770)

Certifications

• Required: CSA and CIS-HAM or CIS-SAM, held or obtained within an agreed window

• Preferred: CMA/CTA for architect-track candidates, and ITAM industry certifications (e.g. IAITAM)

title: AI Transformation Coordinator
description:
We are looking for and AI Transformation Coordinator - not a technical expert, but an effective communicator, automations enthusiast, who
ensures AI is adopted safely, practically and consistently across E&C, and turns business needs into useful AI solutions.
LOCATION : Remote work is possible, however the E&C’er needs to be located within European E&C entities: E&C Group Locations
Why E&C Consultants?
You can read more details here: Becoming an E&Cer, but in big lines:

• We are a Great Place To Work®certified company - employee satisfaction stamped by our staff

• We provide Growth Opportunities - as E&C continues to expand, you grow with us

• We implemented a Flexible and Empowering Culture - we pioneer with our unique Teal management style, which includes Empowerment, Ownership, Self-Management, Integrity, Transparency and Trust

• We offer 46 days off / year (yes, 46!) regardless of the country you live & work in

• Remote work is possible but the E&C’er has to be located in the European E&C entity

Why did we decide to create such a role at E&C?
Most of the value in AI is not in the tools themselves. It is in the distance between having access to them and using them well, and that distance is currently being crossed unevenly and informally across the business. This role exists to close that gap deliberately: to make good practice visible and repeatable, to stop capable people from spending hours rediscovering what a colleague solved last month, and to make sure the initiatives we invest in are the ones that actually pay back. Equally, the role exists to apply judgement about where AI is not the answer - an honest recommendation to keep a process manual, or to solve it with a spreadsheet, a script or a conversation, is as valuable as an automation delivered.
What would you be trusted with if you join us?

• Identify and prioritize AI use cases by working with teams to understand pain points, expected value, feasibility and data sensitivity

• Measure and report business impact (usage, hours returned, cycle‑time improvements, automated workflows, cost vs benefit)

• Be a point of contact for our E&Cers for AI questions & ideas

• Design and deliver targeted training, policies & guidance ( with the help of our amazing HR and Admin teams ) , workshops and knowledge sessions tailored to different audiences and technical confidence levels.

• Shape a network of AI champions embedded across functions to sustain capability building

• Partner with IT to ensure AI use aligns with information security, data governance and records requirements, help mitigate risks (client confidentiality, personal data, IP, output accuracy and appropriate human oversight)

It’s a very new role - so, fair question: what success looks like?
In 12 months we’d hope for:

• Increased enthusiasm and awareness of sensible usage of AI solutions (yes, we know, that’s not something you can really control, but we are all here to support you in making it happen!)

• A clear, documented pathway from idea to deployed AI solution, understood and used across the business

• Measurable growth in active, competent use of approved AI tools: not licences issued, but work genuinely being done differently

• A published set of AI guidelines that E&Cers can find, understand and follow, aligned with our security and data governance

• A maintained inventory of AI tools and use cases , with costs and benefits overview

• An active AI champions network reducing reliance on this role as the single point of support

• Reduced duplication across AI initiatives - which investments are returning value and which should stop?

• Not a surprising one - we count on deep, hands-on fluency with current generative AI tools , including assistants, agentic workflows and automation platforms, together with the habit of staying current as the field moves

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
Overview
Consilio builds eDiscovery and legal technology solutions used by legal teams at major organizations. Our users make consequential decisions inside our products - often under deadline, always under scrutiny. The work is high-stakes by nature: decisions made inside our products carry legal weight.
We're looking for a Lead UX Designer to own design for critical areas of our product suite and to serve as a steward of our design system. Two things make this role unusual. First, you'll be working out how AI shows up inside these workflows. Second, you'll be setting the standards that hold the experience together across a multi-product portfolio, and governing how those standards get used.
This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, and you'll have real influence over what gets built.
How this role operates
You'll partner with Product and Engineering early - shaping the problem, not styling a decision that's already been made. You'll prototype fast to explore and align, and work with Engineering to keep design and code in sync.
Our internal design team is small and growing. You'll have more ownership than you'd get at a mature design org, and less existing infrastructure to lean on.
Responsibilities
· Own end-to-end design for one or more product areas, from problem framing through delivery and post-launch iteration
· Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early, not just execute on requirements
· Translate in-flight product strategy into journeys, information architecture, and interaction patterns
· Define the interaction models for AI-assisted workflows: how users understand what the system did, why it did it, and how far to trust it
· Evolve and maintain Consilio's design system - defining components and patterns, and setting the standards for how they're used
· Build accessibility standards into the system rather than retrofitting it
· Prototype rapidly to explore, align, and de-risk decisions using modern AI tools
· Lead or partner on user research, and turn findings into decisions other people can act on
· Make the case for design decisions and system standards to senior stakeholders through evidence and clear storytelling
Qualifications
· 8+ years designing complex enterprise or B2B software, with shipped work you can walk us through
· Hands-on experience building and maintaining a design system in a multi-product environment - not just consuming one
· Experience designing end-to-end journeys for multi product ecosystems
· Experience with Figma Make, or other similar prompt-based prototyping tools.
· Depth in interaction design, with visual craft strong enough to make the work persuasive
· Demonstrated experience partnering with Product and Engineering from problem definition forward
· Bachelor’s degree in Design (e.g., Interaction, Visual, Industrial Design), HCI, or equivalent practical experience.
Qualities we're looking for
· Systems thinking. You design for scale and consistency by default, not as a cleanup pass.
· Standards judgment. You know when to generalize a pattern and when a one-off is the right answer - and you can say no to a component request without damaging the relationship.
· Comfort with ambiguity. You can make a defensible tradeoff without perfect information, and revisit it when better information arrives.
· Influence without authority. You change what gets built by being persuasive and well-reasoned, not by escalating.
· Clarity under complexity. You can take a genuinely complicated workflow and make it feel obvious.
Portfolio
· Strong portfolio demonstrating complex workflow design across multiple web-based enterprise products.
· Work samples that showcase prototyping ability.
Nice to have
· Experience with AI driven products or designing AI powered interactions
· Formal or self-directed learning in AI/ML concepts
· Prior experience designing for legal, compliance, healthcare, financial services, or another high-consequence regulated domain.

The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

About Competitive Enterprise Institute:
 
The Competitive Enterprise Institute is a nonprofit think tank based in Washington which focuses on critical economic and regulatory policy issues.
 
CEI’s internship program provides interested students and recent graduates the opportunity to learn about and promote the principles of limited government, free enterprise, and individual liberty. A CEI internship gives applicants the opportunity to work alongside some of the most prominent regulatory affairs scholars and policy specialists.
 
CEI offers a number of internships across the various policy areas we work on, as well as internships in communications and marketing. Generally, CEI’s policy interns are assigned to work with a specific CEI expert for the duration of their internship; and our communications and marketing interns work with the CEI staff of each respective team.
 
CEI’s internship program is an invaluable educational experience. We work with interns to help them grow professionally, hone their skills, and cultivate lasting relationships. Ultimately, our goal is to give interns work that will help them further their careers. Interns are encouraged to be proactive, and exceptional interns are often given the freedom to shape their experience with us and the possibility to explore other opportunities at CEI.
 
Past CEI interns have gone on to work in the executive and legislative branches, federal regulatory agencies, academia, and at prominent research institutions and think tanks. A number of current CEI staff are former CEI interns.
 
You can find out more about CEI here and learn about our history here. You can see our team of experts here, and see some of our work here and here.
 
Marketing Intern:
Marketing interns assist with social media management, email marketing, video and podcasting editing, CEI website management, and the development of promotional materials. 
 
Qualifications:
Applicants must have a strong interest in policy and politics, capitalism and economics, and libertarian/conservative principles. Applicants must have strong research, writing, and organizational skills. Applicants must possess a professional demeanor and the ability to handle confidential and private information. Applicants should be able to work independently, effectively, and efficiently. A basic understanding of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook is a must.
 
CEI also seeks interns to work on policy/research, marketing - and from time to time, philanthropy/fundraising, government affairs, events, litigation, and IT. During the interview, we would be more than happy to discuss these other opportunities if they are available and of interest to you!
 
This role is in person, in Washington, D.C.

title: Product Owner - Customer Experience
description:
Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de http://Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu http://Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at http://Gurkerl.at, and Sezamo.ro http://Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items delivered within hours in 15-minute windows.

How our customers shop is rapidly evolving. While our mobile app and website have long been the primary touchpoints, increasingly it also means an ongoing conversation with Maia, our proprietary AI shopping assistant already handling tens of thousands of conversations daily.

We are looking for a Product Owner to take accountability for a distinct segment of the customer journey-spanning areas across search & discovery, personalization, basket, slot choice, checkout, order tracking, substitutions, Rohlik Xtra, or Maia-and make it measurably better week after week.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- High-velocity deployment: Work directly with engineers who ship to production multiple times a day behind feature flags. A decision made on Monday reaches live customers by Tuesday.

- Radical customer obsession: We prioritize decisions that deliver genuine value to the household on the other end of the order, even when they are harder for us to build.

- AI-first environment: Build in a modern setup where product engineers and product owners use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Devin daily for fast vibe-coding and rapid prototyping.

- Multi-market operational impact: Directly influence how a single product scales across five European markets, solving complex operational seams like out-of-stocks, substitutions, and slot capacity.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN AND DELIVER

- Journey outcomes & metrics: Own the business and customer metrics for your agreed part of the journey, making day-to-day prioritization decisions that directly drive performance.

- First-hand customer insights: Talk to customers weekly through interviews, home visits, customer care shadowing, and feedback channels. Turn real observations into crisp problem statements and validated backlog items.

- Backlog management: Translate the product vision into explicit problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Make clear calls on what ships, what waits, and what gets cut.

- Hypothesis-driven experimentation: Design A/B tests with clear hypotheses and pre-defined kill metrics. Evaluate performance independently and sunset features that fail to deliver value.

- Hands-on analytics: Query product analytics and the data warehouse directly using SQL. Report weekly performance metrics and distinguish product impact from operational noise.

- Prototyping & cell delivery: Embed daily with a dedicated 3-5 person engineering cell as the voice of the customer. Vibe-code early prototypes using AI tooling during requirements analysis instead of relying on static mock-ups.

- Five-market product alignment: Balance local operational requirements across CZ, DE, HU, AT, and RO with a unified product vision, using data to justify when to build vs. when to say no.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Product ownership track record: 3+ years owning a consumer product backlog on web or native apps as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with a proven track record of shipping features with clear metrics.

- Data-driven analytical skills: Strong SQL proficiency and experience designing and reading A/B tests. Ability to distinguish statistically significant results from noise and pair numbers with qualitative user insights.

- Hands-on experience with AI tooling: Experience using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to build prototypes, along with a practical perspective on where LLMs add real value in a retail shopping funnel.

- Stakeholder management without authority: Strong persuasion and communication skills to align engineers, design, Commercial, and Operations behind product decisions without formal reporting authority.

- Language requirements: Fluent Englis

title: Package Reliability Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Package Reliability Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own the reliability of our packaged products, from defining mission profiles and reliability targets to identifying package-level failure mechanisms, developing qualification strategies, and making evidence-based release recommendations.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Architecture, Device Reliability, Product Engineering, and OSAT/laboratory partners to translate product use cases into mission profiles and FIT/MTBF targets. You will assess reliability risks, define and execute package-level reliability test plans, lead failure analysis activities, and ensure findings are driven to resolution.

Your core focus will be to transform product requirements into robust reliability strategies, validate package concepts through targeted stress testing, and provide data-driven recommendations that enable confident product release.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

- Own mission profiles and reliability targets by defining product operating conditions (temperature, voltage, humidity, thermal cycling, and lifetime requirements) and allocating FIT, MTBF, and lifetime targets across package, interconnect, and device-level contributors.

- Assess package reliability risks by evaluating failure mechanisms across substrates, die attach, interconnects, solder joints, board attach, and optical/fiber interfaces, including delamination, warpage, fatigue, electromigration, and optical or electrical drift.

- Define and execute package reliability qualification plans covering thermal, mechanical, environmental, and board-level stress testing in accordance with JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, IEC, and customer-specific requirements.

- Lead the technical interface with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and labs, defining reliability requirements, reviewing data, and challenging results when the supporting evidence is insufficient or unrepresentative.

- Drive root-cause investigations and failure analysis, leveraging techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, SEM/EDX, and related methods, and translate findings into CAPA/8D actions, design improvements, and requalification decisions.

- Develop risk-based qualification strategies for novel packaging technologies, such as UBC and optical interconnects, where industry standards are incomplete or do not yet exist.

- Provide data-driven release recommendations by assessing whether products are ready for customer sampling, qualification milestones, or production release, while clearly communicating any remaining reliability risks.

Your Qualifications

- Educational background with a Master's degree (or equivalent experience) i

description:
Are you a Mapudungun language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful tools for communication, education, and cultural preservation. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can accurately capture Mapudungun vocabulary, grammar, dialectical variations, and cultural context-helping preserve Indigenous knowledge and support authentic linguistic interactions. title: Client Services Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Client Services Specialist who can take genuine ownership of our client relationships.
Your job is to make sure clients feel supported, informed, and confident in the work we’re doing together. You’ll keep commitments moving, spot risks before they become problems, and ensure that important details don’t disappear into an inbox, meeting, or Slack thread.

This is not a reactive customer-support role. It’s also not a role where “following up” simply means asking everybody else for an update.

We need someone who can understand what a client is trying to achieve, coordinate the work required to get them there, and confidently own the communication along the way.

What you’ll be responsible for

• Build strong, trusted relationships with our clients.

• Understand each client’s goals, priorities, expectations, and current sentiment.

• Serve as the bridge between clients and the internal team.

• Lead client meetings and turn conversations into clear decisions, owners, and deadlines.

• Make sure every commitment is properly recorded and followed through.

• Keep ClickUp and client records accurate enough that another team member can confidently step in when needed.

• Proactively communicate progress, delays, risks, and changes-before clients need to ask.

• Identify unhappy, disengaged, or at-risk clients early and coordinate an appropriate response.

• Manage onboarding, ongoing client rhythms, milestones, renewals, and cancellations with care.

• Coordinate smooth handovers and coverage when somebody is out of office.

• Escalate issues with context, possible solutions, and a clear recommendation.

• Help improve the systems and processes we use to deliver a consistently excellent client experience.

What success looks like:

• Clients know what is happening and what comes next.

• Internal team members understand exactly what they own.

• Commitments have named owners and realistic due dates.

• Risks are surfaced early rather than discovered during a crisis.

• Client information is current, clear, and easy to find.

• Meetings end with decisions and action, not additional confusion.

• Leave and handovers do not disrupt the client experience.

• Leadership does not need to chase you for updates or remind you about follow-ups.

• Clients see you as a trusted partner rather than simply a point of contact.

You’ll probably be great at this if you:

• Are naturally warm, thoughtful, and confident with people.

• Communicate clearly without sounding robotic or overly corporate.

• Have excellent follow-through and notice when something is about to fall through a gap.

• Can bring structure to situations that are still slightly messy.

• Take ownership without waiting to be told about every next step.

• Are comfortable having honest conversations when expectations, scope, or timelines need to be addressed.

• Can distinguish between something urgent, something important, and something that can wait.

• Stay calm when a client is frustrated.

• Ask good questions and listen closely to the answers.

• Enjoy creating clarity, improving processes, and leaving things better documented than you found them.

• Can work independently while keeping the right people informed.

This role may not suit you if

• You need detailed instructions before taking action.

• You avoid difficult client conversations.

• You regularly rely on memory instead of documenting information.

• You consider sending a message to be the same as completing the follow-through.

• You wait for a client to complain before addressing a concern.

• You enjoy talking to clients but dislike the operational work required behind the scenes.

• You need frequent chasing to close loops.

Experience

• We care more about judgment, ownership, and communication than a perfect CV

• Experience in client success, WordPress development, Google Analytics and good understanding of technical SEO, account management, project coordination, or a service-based bus

title: Investigator, Special Investigative Unit
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary Provides investigative support for special investigation unit (SIU) activities. Responsible for supporting for the prevention, detection, investigation, reporting, and when appropriate, recovery of money related to health care fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA). Responsible for reviewing and analyzing information to draw conclusions on allegations of FWA and/or may determine appropriateness of care, and recognizing and adhering to national and local coding and billing guidelines in order to maintain coding accuracy and excellence.
Essential Job Duties

• Responsible for developing leads presented to the special investigation unit (SIU) to assess and determine whether potential fraud, waste, or abuse (FWA) is corroborated by evidence.
• Conducts both preliminary assessments of FWA allegations, and end-to-end investigations, including but not limited to witness interviews, background checks, data analytics to identify outlier billing behavior, contract and program regulation research, provider and member education, findings identification and communications development, recommendations and preparation of overpayment identifications, and closure of investigative cases.
• Completes investigations within the mandated period of time required by either state and/or federal contracts and/or regulations.
• Conducts both on-site and desktop investigations.
• Conducts low to medium, and extensive investigations, including reviews of medical records and data analysis, and makes determinations as to whether the investigation and/or audit identified potential FWA.
• Performs accurate and reliable medical review audits that may also include coding and billing reviews.
• Produces audit reports for internal and external review.
• Coordinates with various internal customers (e.g., provider services, contracting and credentialing, healthcare services, member services, claims, etc.), to gather documentation pertinent to investigations.
• Detects potential health care FWA through the identification of aberrant coding and/or billing patterns through utilization review.
• Prepares appropriate FWA referrals to regulatory agencies and law enforcement.
• Documents appropriately all case related information in the case management system in an accurate manner, including storage of case documentation following SIU related requirements.
• Prepares detailed preliminary and extensive investigation referrals to state and/or federal regulatory and/or law enforcement agencies when FWA is identified as required by regulatory and/or contract requirements.
• Renders provider education on appropriate practices (e.g., coding) as appropriate based on national or local guidelines, contractual, and/or regulatory requirements.
• Interacts with regulatory and/or law enforcement agencies regarding case investigations.
• Prepares audit results letters to providers when overpayments are identified.
• Ensures compliance with applicable contractual requirements, and federal and state regulations.
• Complies with SIU policies as and procedures as well as goals set by SIU leadership.
• Supports SIU in arbitrations, legal procedures, and settlements.
• Actively participates in Medicaid Fraud Control Unit (MFCU) meetings and roundtables on FWA case development and referrals.
• May work with other internal departments, including compliance, corporate legal counsel, and medical affairs to achieve and maintain appropriate anti-fraud oversight.

Required Qualifications

• At least 2 years of investigative experience in the health care industry, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
• Valid and unrestricted driver’s license.

title: Senior HR Business Consultant
description:
Jij maakt het mogelijk
Een CEO die met 80 mensen een reorganisatie in moet en jou belt voordat hij het zijn MT vertelt. Een leiderschapsteam dat jouw hulp inroept omdat het na twee jaar hard groeien merkt dat de oude manier van werken vastloopt. Een collega-VIE'er die bij een eerste groot veranderproject even met je wil sparren over hoe ze de weerstand in het team aanpakt. En dat is slechts een deel van je werkweek.
Als Senior HR Business Consultant ben je de sparringpartner van founders, CEO's en MT's van ambitieuze groeibedrijven en werk je voor meerdere bedrijven tegelijkertijd. Je weet wat er speelt als een organisatie van 40 naar 150 mensen gaat en je helpt ze daar doorheen: organisatie-inrichting, leiderschap, cultuur, performance. Vooral verandering is jouw ding. Je weet dat een nieuwe structuur bedenken makkelijk is en dat het echte werk begint zodra mensen er iets van gaan vinden.
Je kijkt ook verder dan je eigen opdrachten: waar kunnen we een klant nog beter helpen, welke nieuwe klant past bij ons, wat hebben we nodig om te groeien? VIE staat voor een volgende stap en we willen dat jij een van de mensen bent die mee gaat bouwen aan onze organisatie.
Requirements
Jij hebt het
Je hebt ruime ervaring in HR, als HR-lead , HR-manager, coach, veranderkundige of consultant, en je hebt aan tafel gezeten bij een MT. Je hebt organisaties zien groeien, krimpen of veranderen en kan goed tegen verandering. Verder herken je jezelf hierin:

• Je hebt mensen aangestuurd en je vindt het oprecht leuk om anderen beter te maken. Je geeft feedback die ergens over gaat en je trekt je team mee zonder alles zelf te willen doen.

• Je denkt commercieel. Je ziet kansen bij klanten, je durft het gesprek over een vervolgopdracht aan te gaan en je vindt het niet vies om over omzet te praten.

• Je hebt verandertrajecten geleid en weet hoe je een organisatie meekrijgt.

• Je bent ondernemend en wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat er moet gebeuren.

• Je gelooft meer in de waarde van een goede confrontatie dan in de status quo behouden. Daarom stel je de vraag achter de vraag, ook als dat ongemakkelijk is. En als je vastloopt, vraag je hulp.

• Je gebruikt tech en AI in je werk omdat je snapt dat het je tijd geeft voor wat er echt toe doet.

• Je begrijpt hoe organisaties werken en kan HR-overstijgend meedenken en kijken.

• Je voelt je thuis bij onze kernwaarden: samen doen, oprecht direct en beter maken.

Dit verdien jij

• Een team collega's met samen honderden jaren People & Culture-ervaring, en een plek waar je die ervaring zelf ook doorgeeft

• Werk bij uiteenlopende groeibedrijven, met ondernemers die weten wat ze willen (of juist niet, en daar help je dan bij)

• Regie over je eigen agenda en de vrijheid om nationale feestdagen op te nemen wanneer het voor jou belangrijk is en autonomie over je eigen werk

• Tijd om je in te zetten voor een goed doel of vrijwilligerswerk. We zijn niet voor niets een B Corp

• Een salaris dat past bij je ervaring en bij deze rol binnen de range van € 5.083 - € 6.877, plus de rest van onze voorwaarden die je hier vindt

Hoe verder?
Nieuwsgierig? Laten we koffie drinken, gerust eerst gewoon om kennis te maken. Neem direct contact op met Wouter, CEO van VIE People , via of +31 (0) 6 506 025 72.

Title: Sr Director Mergers & AcquisitionsLocation: Statewide Multi Use, ILJob Requisition ID: Req-272022Time Type: Full time
About Lamb Weston

You’ve probably enjoyed our fries without even knowing it! As a leading manufacturer in our industry, we inspire and bring people together with foods they love and trust. Our customer base includes international food service providers, restaurants, and households in over 100 countries around the world.

A highly innovative global corporation with a start-up mindset, we empower every individual to make a genuine difference. You’ll gain access to hands-on training to fuel your growth and success, explore opportunities for new solutions, and you’ll join a winning team of 10,000+ people all dedicated to raising the bar - together.

If you have a strong drive for results, a desire to help us bring the world together through our fries, and are ready for a fresh challenge, we want to hear from you.
Job Description Summary
At Lamb Weston , we don't pursue transactions for their own sake. We invest behind long-term value creation.
As Senior Director, Mergers & Acquisitions, you will serve as the Company's lead to Corporate M&A and principal advisor to the CFO, CEO, and Executive Chairman on acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments. You will help determine where the Company deploys capital, identify transformational opportunities, lead transaction execution, and drive value realization following close.
This role offers a unique opportunity for an accomplished investment banker or corporate development leader to transition from advising clients to directly influencing enterprise strategy and investment decisions within a $6+ billion global public company.
Reporting directly to the CFO, you will operate at the highest levels of the organization, regularly engaging with the executive leadership team, our Executive Chairman and CEO, and the Board of Directors on matters critical to the Company's future growth and shareholder value creation.
Why This Role
This position offers the opportunity to:
•Partner directly with the CFO, CEO, and Executive Chairman on corporate strategy and capital allocation decisions
•Lead strategic acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and investment opportunities from origination through value realization
•Influence long-term enterprise growth strategy through M&A across global markets and business segments
•Present directly to Executive Chairman, CEO and the Board of Directors
•Expand beyond transaction execution into enterprise finance leadership, strategic planning, and business decision-making
•Build broad operating experience while working alongside leaders across Finance, Strategy, Legal, Commercial, Operations, Supply Chain and HR functions
Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Corporate Development and Strategic Growth
Partner with Corporate Strategy leadership to shape and execute Lamb Weston 's inorganic growth agenda.
You will:

• Identify, evaluate, and prioritize acquisition, partnership, joint venture, and investment opportunities in line with Lamb Weston ’s strategy

• Develop M&A investment theses aligned with long-term growth objectives

• Monitor industry trends, competitive dynamics, market disruptions, and emerging opportunities

• Maintain executive-level relationships with investment bankers, advisors, and potential transaction counterparties

• Serve as a strategic thought partner to senior leadership on transaction alternatives and capital deployment

Transaction Leadership
Lead transactions from opportunity assessment through deal execution.
You will:

• Source and evaluate acquisition opportunities

• Build and oversee advanced valuation, financial modeling, and scenario-planning analyses

• Lead negotiations alongside senior executives and external advisors

• Direct comprehensive due diligence activities across financial, operational, commercial, tax, human resources and in conjunction with Legal team

• Structure

title: Fachlicher Softwaretester (m/w/d) Bankanwendungen
description:
Deine Rolle
Du kennst den Bankalltag und weißt, worauf es bei Qualität und Genauigkeit wirklich ankommt? Dann ist das deine Chance, deine bankfachliche Erfahrung in die Welt der Softwarequalität einzubringen.
Als Softwaretester (m/w/d) im Bankenumfeld verbindest du dein Verständnis für Abläufe, Produkte und Prozesse im Bankgeschäft mit einem Blick für technische Details. Du prüfst, ob neue oder weiterentwickelte Systeme fachlich korrekt funktionieren, also so wie Bankkaufleute sie wirklich brauchen.
Wenn du also aus der Bank kommst und mehr Einblick in die IT gewinnen möchtest oder bereits als Softwaretester im Bankumfeld tätig bist und deine bankfachliche Expertise weiter ausbauen willst, bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Über uns
Die CPU Consulting & Software GmbH  ist seit über vier Jahrzehnten als IT-Partner der Finanzbranche erfolgreich. Als Teil der CPU-Gruppe verbinden wir tiefes  Banking-Know-how  mit Technologiekompetenz und begleiten Banken sowie IT-Dienstleister bei der digitalen Transformation - von der Idee bis zum Go-live.
Du stellst sicher, dass Softwarelösungen nicht nur technisch einwandfrei , sondern auch fachlich präzise und bankkonform umgesetzt werden. Damit leistest du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Qualität und Zukunftssicherheit moderner Banking-Systeme.
Aufgaben

• Du analysierst Anforderungen und entwickelst darauf basierend Testfälle und Testkonzepte.

• Du führst manuelle und automatisierte Tests durch und dokumentierst Ergebnisse präzise.

• Du unterstützt bei Abnahmetests direkt beim Kunden und begleitest Fachbereiche bei der Einführung neuer Systeme.

• Du trägst zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Teststrategie bei und bringst neue Ideen zur Qualitätssicherung ein.

• Du arbeitest eng mit Business Analysten, Entwicklern und Fachabteilungen zusammen - auf Augenhöhe und lösungsorientiert.

Qualifikation

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Bankkaufmann/-frau oder bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bankwesen mit.

• Du bist neugierig auf IT und möchtest deine bankfachliche Expertise in Softwareprojekte einbringen .

• Alternativ hast du bereits Erfahrung als Softwaretester im Bankumfeld.

• Eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung ist von Vorteil, ebenso wie Erfahrung mit Testtools wie Jira, Confluence, Aqua, Postman, Selenium, Cypress oder FitNesse.

• Du arbeitest strukturiert, qualitätsbewusst und verlierst auch in komplexen Szenarien nicht den Überblick.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

Benefits

•
Zukunftssicherheit:
Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und eine Bezuschussung der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% geben dir Stabilität und Sicherheit für deine Zukunft.

•
Innovatives und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld:
Wir bieten dir eine langfristige Perspektive in einer Branche, die sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt mit Raum für persönliches Wachstum. Durch gezielte Schulungen erhältst du die Möglichkeit, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und dich in der IT-Welt weiterzubilden.

•
Attraktive Vergütung:
Wir schätzen deine Leistungen! Im Hinblick auf deine Qualifikationen bieten wir dir eine Vergütung zwischen 55.000 und 85.000 Euro brutto im Jahr, abhängig von Berufserfahrung und Senioritäten-Level.

•
Flexibilität:
Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gleitzeitkonto und die Möglichkeit mobil zu arbeiten, um dein Berufs- und Privatleben optimal miteinander zu vereinbaren.

•
Benefits :
Nutze unser attraktives Hardware- und Bike Leasing sowie den Zugang zu einem Mitarbeiterrabattportal mit 600 namenhaften Unternehmen und spare dabei Geld.

Du findest dich in unserem Profil wieder? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! Bitte sende uns hierzu deine vollständige, deutschsprachige Bewerbung mit frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung zu.

title: Digital Content and Marketing Coordinator - REMOTE
description:
About ACLED

Armed Conflict Location & Event Data ( ACLED ) is an independent, impartial conflict and protest monitoring organization providing real-time data and analysis on violent conflict and protest in all countries and territories across the world.
The Role
We are looking for a Digital Content and Marketing Coordinator who will play a critical role in driving audience acquisition, engagement, and pipeline generation across ACLED 's core customer and partner segments. This is a hands-on role where you will be tasked with content creation, appealing to new market sectors, digital marketing of email campaigns, webinars, events, and product communications initiatives. You will be responsible for building and scaling programs that convert ACLED 's global audience into active users, partners, and customers.
You will work cross-functionally with sales, research, and a specific market focused director to translate ACLED 's data and insights into compelling campaigns that drive measurable growth. The ideal candidate will blend creativity with analytical rigor and action, and who thrives in creating repeatable growth from the ground up.
This position is fully remote and takes part in the marketing team leadership, and reports to the Director of Revenue, with a dotted line to the Strategic Advisor.
Specific Roles and Responsibilities
Growth & Demand Generation

• Own and execute ACLED 's growth strategy across key channels, with a focus on pipeline generation and audience expansion.

• Build and optimize multi-channel campaigns that drive engagement, conversion, and revenue.

• Develop and continuously improve lead generation and nurturing funnels in partnership with sales.

• Generate ideas and campaigns around ACLED products and initiatives

Email & Automation

• Own the email program end-to-end (newsletters, nurture sequences, campaign sends).

• Segment audiences and personalize messaging to improve engagement and conversion rates.

• Build automated workflows and lead scoring within CRM and automation tools (e.g., Salesforce).

• Continuously test and optimize subject lines, content, and cadence based on performance data.

Webinars & Virtual Events

• Own the overall strategy and operational execution of industry events, webinars, and virtual roundtables as a core growth channel.

• Identify themes, speakers, and target audiences aligned with ACLED 's commercial priorities.

• Drive webinar promotion, registration, attendance, and post-event conversion.

• Repurpose webinar content into ongoing content assets.

• Manage event promotion, logistics, and follow-up to maximize pipeline impact.

• Partner with sales to ensure effective pre- and post-event engagement strategies.

Product Communications

• Translate ACLED 's data products and insights into clear, compelling value propositions and messaging.

• Own and/or support product launches, feature releases, and positioning across target segments.

• Develop sales collateral (one-pagers, decks, case studies) that enable sales and educate buyers.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align messaging across research, analysis, and revenue teams.

Analytics & Optimization

• Track, measure, and report on campaign performance across all channels (email, events, webinars, digital).

• Use data to identify trends, optimize campaigns, and improve ROI.

• Build reporting frameworks tied to growth and revenue goals.

• Develop a strategy to optimize ACLED ’s Linkedin profile and increase audience reach and target.

Skills and Competencies
ACLED is seeking applicants who have the following skills and experience:

• 5+ years of proven experience in marketing and digital roles, ideally from the impact sector (tech for good, global social enterprise, or commercial experience from an INGO), identifying target audiences and leading campaigns that engage, educate, and motivate.

• Self-starter, with experience working remotely, who has a desire to learn, grow, and excel in their role.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY
Join an international technology environment focused on building modern enterprise data platforms and enabling data-driven decision-making at scale. As a Data Architect, you will shape the architecture of a cloud-based data platform, defining the standards, models and integration patterns needed to deliver reliable, scalable and well-governed data products.
This is an opportunity for an experienced Data Architect who combines strategic architectural thinking with practical solution design. You will work closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Analytics teams and enterprise architects to translate business needs into robust data solutions and influence the long-term evolution of the platform.
PROJECT & CONTEXT
You will lead the design and implementation of a modern enterprise data platform built on Databricks and Azure , establishing a scalable Lakehouse architecture aligned with enterprise requirements and platform best practices.
Your responsibilities will include defining target-state data architecture, designing conceptual, logical and physical data models, and establishing standards for data modelling, integration and governance. You will ensure that business entities and data structures are consistently represented across the platform while supporting reliable data consumption by engineering, reporting and analytics teams.
You will also define data governance principles covering lineage, metadata management, cataloguing, security and access patterns. Working closely with Data Engineers, you will review solution designs, guide implementation decisions and support performance, scalability and cost optimisation.

You will contribute to the platform roadmap and help ensure that architectural decisions support both current business requirements and future enterprise needs.

• Experience designing enterprise-scale Data Warehouses, Data Lakes or Lakehouse platforms .

• Practical experience designing scalable Databricks Lakehouse architectures using platform best practices.

• Strong SQL skills and an understanding of enterprise data structures and data processing requirements.

• Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services and cloud-based data platform architecture.

• Ability to translate business requirements into scalable data models, architecture designs and integration patterns.

• Experience defining architecture standards for data integration, governance and platform development.

• Knowledge of data governance principles, including data lineage, metadata management, cataloguing, security and access control.

• Professional working proficiency in English .

TL;DR - We're seeking an exceptional Design Engineer to build the tooling that makes AI-native brand production actually work at scale. You might call yourself a design engineer, creative technologist or even a full-stack product engineer who cares about craft. Here you’ll be someone who builds real infrastructure specifically in service of brand and creative output, working alongside brand designers who owns taste and direction.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What you'll do

In one sentence: build the front-end surfaces and the AI-generation systems that let Lovable’s brand team produce at scale without losing its taste.

- Build pipelines connecting image/video generation APIs, internal tooling, and the systems brand and marketing already use (Lovable, Design tools, CMS, the marketing site, Slack)

- Constantly evaluate new models, APIs, and generation tooling as the landscape moves, and rebuild pipelines when something better comes along

What we're looking for

- Solid engineering fundamentals - you have a track record of building, shipping, and maintaining real full-stack software

- Experience translating scrappy explorations into production-ready systems

- Some design sensibility is a strong plus - you don’t need to be a designer, but you can tell when output is off-brand without it being spelled out, and you enjoy working closely with people who have strong taste

- Comfortable building for a function with no internal precedent - you'll be making calls with no playbook to lean on

- You’ll push the boundaries of what's possible with generative pipelines the way our Design Engineers push the boundaries of the web

Nice to have

- Experience with Lovable or similar AI-native building tools

- Prior work on marketing sites, design systems or brand tooling

- Portfolio or side projects that show both craft and curiosity

Lovable is built with tools that both humans and AI love:

- Frontend: React, Tailwind

- Backend: Golang and Rust

- Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, many LLM and generation providers

- DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

title: Remote Customer Support Specialist
description:
Description
We are looking for dependable, detail-oriented Remote Customer Support Specialists to support a US-based affordable housing services operation.
This opportunity involves supporting residents, prospective tenants, and authorized third-party representatives across three key functions: maintenance support, housing locator services, and open-line reporting.
Depending on the type of inquiry, you may assist residents with submitting maintenance requests, help prospective tenants identify suitable affordable housing opportunities, or document formal reports involving concerns, complaints, compliments, and other requests.
This role requires more than general customer service skills. Successful candidates must be excellent communicators, accurate recordkeepers, and confident in asking probing questions to gather complete information. You must also be able to remain professional, objective, and emotionally composed when handling sensitive or potentially distressing situations.
Candidates must be flexible and available to work any of the listed shifts, as assignments will be determined according to business needs.
Key Responsibilities
Maintenance Support

• Handle inbound calls from residents requesting maintenance work orders for their individual units, community grounds, or buildings.

• Ask relevant questions to understand reported issues and accurately document caller information and detailed descriptions of maintenance concerns in the YardiOne online portal.

• Ensure information is complete and clear to support appropriate follow-up by maintenance personnel.

Housing Locator

• Handle inbound calls from prospective tenants interested in applying for affordable housing or joining property waitlists.

• Gather and document caller information and housing preferences.

• Use YardiOne to identify matching properties and generate lists containing property contact information and waitlist status.

• Send requested property lists by email or physical mail within 48 hours.

Open-Line Support

• Handle inbound calls from residents and third-party representatives regarding concerns, compliments, and requests unrelated to maintenance.

• Ask probing questions, accurately document formal reports in the designated web portal, and route them to the appropriate property leadership based on established criteria, including whether the caller has previously contacted property staff.

• Handle sensitive topics, including abuse, security concerns, and evictions, with professionalism and strict objectivity.

• Maintain emotional composure, avoid personal opinions, and do not offer apologies when documenting formal reports, as these calls may be used in formal proceedings.

Technical Requirements (Non-Negotiable)
Applicants must have their own equipment and a suitable home workspace that meets all of the following requirements:

• Windows 11 PC (Mac not supported)

• Minimum 16 GB RAM

• Intel i5 processor or higher

• Dual monitors

• Webcam and wired USB headset

• Fiber internet with a wired Ethernet connection

• Backup power solution

• Microsoft Teams and Office 365

Applications that do not meet the minimum technical requirements may not move forward in the hiring process.

•
Rate: $5.50 USD per hour

•

•

•

•

•
1:00 PM-10:00 PM: Thursday-Monday.

Each schedule includes two consecutive days off.
Applicants must be available and willing to work any of the schedules listed. Your assigned shift and working days will be determined based on business needs. You must be able to commit consistently to you
